integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: What CRM sends to and takes from the other products. Each link is set in crm.yaml.
integrations.audienceDetail: Contacts and deal events go there; a deal shows what the lead did on the site.
integrations.erasure: A person deleted in Audience is deleted here too (POST /api/v1/erasures, with a CRM token of the admin role).
integrations.messagesDetail: Sales sequences are Messages journeys, started by the sequence's event.
integrations.helpdeskDetail: Helpdesk shows the customer and their deals beside each ticket, and routes by the company's plan.
integrations.liveChatDetail: An agent opens a lead from a chat; forms and your systems call the same.
integrations.leadsGo: Leads start in {{stage}}; owned by the member who sent them, else {{owner}}.
integrations.mailDetail: Task reminders and quotes sent by email.
integrations.mailOff: No mail server in crm.yaml: reminders show in the app only.
integrations.apiDetail: Deals and activities from your own systems, with an API token.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Pipelines, quotes, meeting links and the links to other products, as {{file}} sets them.
settings.readOnlyDetail: Change them in the file and review the change like code; CRM reads it again within a minute. A file with a mistake leaves the last good version in place.
settings.noFile: No settings file: the defaults are in use.
settings.pipelineDetail: A deal counts toward the forecast at its value times its stage's probability.
settings.rolesValue: Viewers see everything; editors change what they own or nobody owns; admins change everything. Roles are set under Members.

auth.accountDetail: Your name, password and second factors.
auth.membersDetail: Who works in CRM, and their role: viewers see everything, editors change what they own, admins change everything and manage members and tokens.
auth.signinDetail: How people sign in: passwords, and identity providers over OIDC.
auth.tokensDetail: Tokens for scripts and other products, each with one role and an expiry. Helpdesk needs a viewer token, Live Chat an editor token, Audience an admin token.
auth.askAnAdmin: Ask an admin of this CRM.
